    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/conflict: The run returns c.txt, and c.txt/d below it.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        out/echo/c.txt can't be held in an archive: the section is also the directory of out/echo/c.txt/d.
        Fix the code. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/doubled: The run returns two outputs at one path.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The run returned two outputs at b.txt.
        Fix the code. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/framework: The run returns an output at a name the framework owns.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The run returned an output at outcome, a name the framework owns under out/echo/.
        Rename the output. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/matched: The run returns an output two declarations match.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        out/echo/a.txt matches two of echo's output declarations, ?.txt and a.txt.
        Change the patterns so that one declaration matches each file. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/render-nonl: RenderError gives the run's error with no final newline.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The project's RenderError returned "rendered: boom" for echo's error, which doesn't end with a newline.
        Its output must end with a newline: fix RenderError. An update writes nothing for this cell.
        echo returned an error, but the case states no property echo rejects:
          boom
        Fix the code, or state the property on the case and in echo's Rejects.
    script/render: RenderError panics on the run's error.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The project's RenderError panicked on echo's error: render boom
        Fix RenderError. An update writes nothing for this cell.
        echo returned an error, but the case states no property echo rejects:
          boom
        Fix the code, or state the property on the case and in echo's Rejects.
    script/undeclared: The run returns an output no declaration matches.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        out/echo/notes.txt is not declared.
        Declare it in echo's Outputs, with a description, or fix the code. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/unheld: The run returns an output with no final newline.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        out/echo/b.txt can't be held in an archive: it has no final newline, which an archive adds.
        Fix the code so the output can be held. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    script/up: The run returns an output outside its cell's directory.
        echo: Does what the case's do/ tree says.
        The run returned an output at "../b.txt", which is not a valid slash path under out/echo/.
        Fix the code. An update writes nothing for this cell.
